about.title: About me
about.description:
I'm a Full Stack developer based in Medellín, Colombia. My main focus: building and maintaining course platforms for academies and content creators — from architecture and payments to secure video delivery and performance.
I train Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, and I take its first lesson seriously: technique beats strength. In software that means simple, well-leveraged solutions over unnecessary complexity — code others can read, sites that load fast, systems that are easy to maintain.
I work freelance and remote (English B2), with React, TypeScript, Astro and Python/Django.
